message: The '{0}' interface can only be implemented by the '{1}' project or by another project that has access to its internals.
title: The interface can only be implemented by the project that defines it or by another project that has access to its internals.
rationale: The message closes the '{1}' placeholder with a backtick instead of a single quote, and 'implemented ... from another project' does not match 'implemented by'. The title misplaces 'only' ('can be only implemented').
